Hero.headline: NYC sales guidance for owners, buyers, and investors
Hero.dek: Price the building. Not the brochure.

Home.howToStartBody: Whether you're buying, selling, or investing in NYC, start with one clear path—then open the neighborhood or guide that matches your goal. I'll gather what matters and recommend one practical next step.
Home.directAnswerBody: The right next step in NYC real estate depends on your path (buy, sell, or invest), timeline, ownership type, and how that specific neighborhood and building compete today. Choose a path below, explore a neighborhood guide, or book a consult for a personal recommendation.
Home.choosePathTitle: Start with your goal. Leave with a clear next step.
Home.choosePathBody: Whether you're selling, buying, or investing, I'll gather what matters for your situation and recommend one practical move forward.
Home.pathSellText: Price, prepare, and launch with a clear view of who's buying right now.
Home.pathBuyText: Define what you need before you spend weeks scrolling inventory.
Home.pathInvestText: Weigh returns, risk, and exit options before you commit capital.
Home.howWeWorkTitle: From first conversation to closing—with one advisor guiding the way.
Home.howWeWorkBody: You bring the goal. I bring the market context, pricing judgment, and one next step you can act on—from first conversation through closing.
Home.neighborhoodsTitle: Explore NYC the way people actually search it.
Home.neighborhoodsBody: Local answers, property-type guidance, and a path that matches your goal—buying, selling, or investing in that area.
Home.guidesTitle: Clear answers to the questions that stop deals.
Home.guidesBody: Each guide opens with a direct answer, then NYC-specific steps and a next action.
Home.sellerTitle: What could your NYC property sell for?
Home.sellerBody: A real valuation looks at recent sales, current competition, monthly costs, building health, condition, floor, light, view, and who’s buying now.
Home.proofLine: Manhattan through Staten Island. Condo, co-op, townhouse.

Buy.title: Define the decision before opening every listing.
Buy.howToStartBody: A useful buyer brief connects purchase price, financing, monthly costs, ownership type, building rules, lifestyle, and resale logic—so every tour and offer has a clear filter.
Buy.exploreNeighborhoodsBody: Local stock and price bands change what your brief can buy.
Buy.readyTitle: Ready for a clear next step?
Buy.readyBody: Share your budget, ownership preference, and target areas. I'll turn them into a practical buyer brief and one recommended move forward.

Sell.title: Sell the property—not just the listing.
Sell.body: A strong NYC sale begins with a defensible price, a clear buyer profile and fewer surprises between launch and closing.
Sell.worthTitle: How much is a NYC apartment worth?
Sell.exploreNeighborhoodsBody: Local context changes pricing and buyer demand.

Invest.title: Screen the thesis before falling in love with the asset.
Invest.body: Use consistent assumptions for income, expenses, financing, renovation, regulation and exit value before allocating time or capital.
